newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss train robbers escape with mail sack booty.
newsitem.headline: Swiss train robbers escape with mail sack booty.

text.p: An armed gang, who robbed a Swiss train of mail sacks this week, got away with at least several hundred thousand Swiss francs (dollars), the Swiss postal authority said on Friday.
The total could be more as the PTT authority contacts customers whose cash and other valuables were among the mailings in over 20 postal sacks stolen in the Wednesday night raid.
"This is a conservative estimate. We are still looking for people who can claim damages for lost mailings," a PTT spokesman told reporters.

In one of the most spectacular robberies in quiet Switzerland, five armed robbers commandeered an express passenger train en route to Geneva from Zurich and escaped into surrounding vineyards leaving few clues behind.

No one was injured in the raid when two hooded robbers slipped into the locomotive and forced the driver to bring the train to a halt in a remote spot next to a road where they had getaway cars waiting.

While the driver was handcuffed to a railing in the locomotive, three other robbers broke into the postal carriage at the end of the train where they handcuffed a 33-year-old postal worker to a bench.
